evidence: Wikipedia's article on Hank Williams names Johnny Cash among the artists Williams influenced, citing a Country Music Television column by Chet Flippo on the two men. No direct statement by Cash was read for this edge.

earlier.title: I'm So Lonesome I Could Cry

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Both are a single voice telling you plainly how he feels, over a small, steady band. Listen for how little decoration there is in either, and for the low, even way each man sings, as if talking.

explanation: Johnny Cash grew up in the years when Hank Williams was the biggest name in country music, and he is one of the many singers Williams influenced. It is held at consensus: the influence is standard country history and is listed by Wikipedia, but no statement by Cash himself was read for it.
